description: 4x V100 experimental segmented hash device-stage diagnostic, one run per graph
device_timer_scope: Per-rank target-specific GPU coordinator PTX globaltimer; intervals are not summed across ranks.
storage: Complete evidence archive multicta-metrics-evidence.tgz SHA256 ab0ecd6454e66449ff5878c2a8f9b77aa3d8952041197a007593bb9bcec6c334; compact receipts SHA256 b7c86492495124ca50369044369969fb8703e26287c50ba2438bd624ea68a46a.

hash_metrics.clock: per-rank PTX globaltimer, target-specific; diagnostic only
hash_metrics.scope: one attempted expansion per entry, final entry may be incomplete or empty
hash_metrics.wire_bytes_scope: useful records x 16; excludes protocol and actual link overhead

resident.max_active_shards_scope: accepted rows per attempted layer on this rank; first 64 shards

rank_allocations.resident_extent_pool_scope: preallocated extents; free extents can be leased by any shard
rank_allocations.storage_peak_scope: segment states, index, counters, run directory and descriptors; excludes queue, scratch, CUDA/NCCL internals
